title: N-Queens Count
prompt:
**Description:** Count the ways to place n non-attacking queens on an n x n board
(no two share a row, column, or diagonal).

**Input:** One line: n (1 <= n <= 10).
**Output:** One integer — the number of placements.

**Example:** `4` -> `2`.

tests.name: sample
one
tests.hint: A single queen is trivially safe.

tests.name: two
tests.hint: No placement exists for n = 2 — a solver that never returns 0 is wrong.

tests.name: six
